slots.site-title: Football, art and a little bit of magic
slots.hero-subtitle: Welcome to my corner of the internet. I built it with AI as my co-pilot.
slots.about-me: I am twelve years old and I live in a big city. I love drawing characters, playing football with my friends, and building secret bases in Minecraft. This year I learned how to work with AI: I write prompts, check the results, and make them better, step by step.
slots.hobby-text-1: I play striker for our school team. My dream is to score a bicycle kick in a real match.
slots.hobby-text-2: I draw my own comic characters. AI helps me test new styles, but the ideas are always mine.
slots.hobby-text-3: I build castles and secret underground bases with redstone traps. Engineering is fun.
slots.footer-text: Made with AI as my co-pilot. I am the Operator.
